visual_review.notes: H3 video. The first idle background pulsed dark in time with the furnace breathing, which split the loop with rejected plates; it was retaken with a calm idle and a steady glow and comes back clean on every frame. The attack skips the smeared frames as the clamp swings up and as it turns to snap shut, the hit skips the frames where the clamp brightens and smears, and the death skips the one smeared frame as the robot drops from standing to its knees. The walk loops on frames 31 to 91.
